div.div:
pending and enabled: (mip & mie) has a set bit
to M: bit not in mideleg, and priv < M or MIE = 1
to S: bit in mideleg, and priv = U, or priv = S and SIE = 1 (never while in M)
boundary: no memory stall, no multiply/divide in progress, not in a CSR access
